description: Figure 10 is a line plot illustrating how the model’s evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) changes as the activated parameters ratio varies for different sparsity settings applied to Attention and/or FFN components. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio(%)” on a linear scale, spanning from 100 down to 25, with tick labels at 100, 75, 50, and 25. The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL” on a linear scale, ranging from about 11.5 to 14.0 with regularly spaced tick marks at 11.5, 12.0, 12.5, 13.0, 13.5, and 14.0. Four lines are shown: (1) a red dashed line with circular markers labeled “Transformer,” which stays near 11.5 across the axis, starting around 11.5 at 100 and ending around 11.6 at 25; (2) a gray solid line with square markers labeled “Only MoHD FFN,” which is near 11.5 at 100 and 75, rises to about 11.6 at 50, and ends around 11.8 at 25; (3) a dark blue solid line with circular markers labeled “Only MoHD ATTN,” which starts around 11.5 at 100, is about 11.5 at 75, increases to roughly 12.2 at 50, and reaches about 14.0 at 25; and (4) a light blue solid line with “x” markers labeled “MoHD ATTN + MLP,” which begins around 11.5 at 100, is about 11.5 at 75, increases to roughly 12.0 at 50, and ends near 13.2 at 25.
